pages.title: Room Air Monitor
pages.text: A wall screen for a sealed room's air. Place it inside; no menu.$(br2)Each player breathes $(bold)1 unit$(). Creative and spectator: none.

pages.title: Shared Supply
pages.text: $(bold)SUPPLY$() and $(bold)DEMAND$() cover every connected room. $(bold)LOCAL$() is this room alone.$(br2)Sources must be inside or touching the room. Range does not pass through walls.
A Core touching two rooms shares one 8-unit output.$(br2)Overlapping sources count once.

pages.title: Screen Colors
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Green$(): supported$(li)$(bold)Yellow$(): 80%+ load, overload, or no production$(li)$(bold)Red$(): $(danger)no air, no seal, or NO O2$()$(li)$(bold)Gray$(): WAITING, still indexing

pages.title: Rates, Not Percent
pages.text: It shows rates, not an O2 percentage. Reservoirs show stored player-seconds.$(br2)$(bold)ON RESERVE$(): storage covers a shortfall; the timer is for it.$(br)$(bold)LIMITED$(): storage can't keep up.

pages.title: What Breathes
pages.text: $(li)Torch, lantern, candle: 0.25$(li)Fire, campfire, MiteAway: 1$(li)Furnace, smoker, blast furnace: 3$(li)Animals: extra$(br2)Free: soul flames, heaters, Returned, Architects.
Four iron, two copper, two redstone, one glass. Comparator: 15 no air or seal, 8 strained, 4 no supply.$(br2)$(flavor)Do not argue with the numbers.$()

pages.title: Running Short
pages.text: When demand beats supply, flames go out first, then people suffocate.$(br2)See $(l:heating/running_out_of_air)Running Out of Air$(/l).
